items.title: Oil's Sudden Price Drop Surprises Citi's Chronert
items.summary: Citi Head of US Equity Strategy Scott Chronert says the sudden drop in oil prices on Wednesday surprised him. Brent fell almost 9% then rebounded on Thursday. He says that took some pressure off of the inflation backdrop.
